column2: test_multi_fact::Name two advantages of automated software testing.
column3: Tab 1 Automated software testing offers numerous advantages over manual testing, particularly in modern software development environments. Key benefits include: Automated tests execute significantly faster than manual tests, allowing for more frequent and rapid feedback on code changes. This accelerates the testing cycle and enables quicker release cycles. Automated tests eliminate human error, ensuring consistent execution and accurate results every time. This leads to more reliable bug detection and reduced risk of defects slipping into production. Automation allows for the creation and execution of a larger volume of test cases, including complex and repetitive scenarios that are impractical to test manually. This leads to more comprehensive coverage of the application's functionality. While initial setup requires investment, automated tests can be run repeatedly without additional labor costs, leading to significant cost savings over time compared to the ongoing expense of manual testing. Automated tests can be integrated into the continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline, allowing for automatic execution after every code change. This "shift-left" approach enables early detection and resolution of bugs, which is significantly cheaper than fixing them later in the development cycle. Automated test scripts can be easily adapted and reused across different environments, platforms, and even different projects, promoting scalability and reducing redundant effort. Automation handles repetitive and time-consuming tests, allowing manual testers to focus on more complex, exploratory, and creative testing activities that require human intuition and critical thinking. Automated test reports provide clear and consistent insights into the application's quality
